[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips provided by the assistant include:

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Arrive on time and be flexible: Plan to arrive 10-15 minutes early.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Work as a team: Communicate effectively and help others.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Be mindful of food safety and handling: Follow proper procedures to prevent contamination.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Take initiative and ask questions: Don't hesitate to seek clarification.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Be patient and understanding: Remember that the environment can be fast-paced.
